piel.sense_hint: intensive (this root has no attested qal; piel serves as its basic/citation stem)

notes: Root-key homograph: shares bare consonants שרה with already-shipped H8280 ("prevail") -- distinguished only by sin/shin dot (שָׂרָה vs שָׁרָה), the same shape of overlap as H2820/H2821 (חשך) earlier in this project. Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), H8280 has been retroactively relabeled שרה¹ in this same batch and this root is שרה².

Requested Qal ("let loose") excluded: zero attestation anywhere in the corpus. This root's only occurrence in the entire corpus is the Piel at Jer.15.11 ("Have I not set you free/interceded for you for good?" -- ESV/NASB "set you free").
